recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中大量核圓而濃縮、細胞質由深藍到灰粉紅的紅血球母細胞（normoblasts）成群分布，數量明顯多於顆粒球，並可見含深色鐵顆粒的巨噬細胞，符合紅血球系增生。
features: Numerous erythroid precursors at all stages, predominantly polychromatic and orthochromatic normoblasts
Round central nuclei with condensed checkerboard chromatin and basophilic to grey-pink cytoplasm
Occasional larger proerythroblasts/basophilic normoblasts with deep blue cytoplasm
Granulocytic precursors relatively reduced, giving a decreased M:E ratio
Macrophage with dark green-black pigment (hemosiderin) near the top of the field
Normoblastic maturation without obvious megaloblastic change or multinucleation
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular field with a marked increase in erythroid precursors at all stages of maturation, predominantly polychromatic and orthochromatic normoblasts, resulting in a decreased myeloid-to-erythroid ratio. Erythroid maturation appears normoblastic without significant megaloblastic change, nuclear budding or multinucleation at this magnification. A macrophage containing coarse dark pigment is present. Findings are consistent with erythroid hyperplasia, as seen in hemolysis, blood loss or other causes of increased erythropoietic drive; iron stain and clinical correlation are recommended.

ddx.vs: Erythroid precursors are larger with open, sieve-like chromatin and nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony, accompanied by giant metamyelocytes.
Shows dyserythropoiesis (nuclear budding, multinucleation, ring sideroblasts) with dysplasia in other lineages and often increased myeloblasts.
Is dominated by sheets of highly immature proerythroblasts with vacuolated deep blue cytoplasm (≥30% pronormoblasts, usually with TP53 mutation), not maturing normoblasts.
